title: विशेषसमवायपदार्थपरिशीलनम् [Special cohesive substances]
nepali: प्रस्तुतोऽयमालेखो न्यायवैशेषिकदर्शनयोर्विशेषसमवायपदार्थयोः विवेचने केन्द्रितो वर्तते । गुणात्मकस्वरूपे सज्जीकृतेऽस्मिन् आलेखे पुस्तकालयीयविधिद्वारा प्राप्ततथ्यानां विश्लेषणं विधायान्ते निष्कर्षः प्रस्तुतो वर्तते । अत्र न्यायवैशेषिकाचार्याभिमतयोर्विशेषसमवायपदार्थयोः स्वरूपं विश्लिष्टं विद्यते । आस्तिकदर्शनेषु काणाददर्शनं वैशेषिकनाम्ना कथं विख्यातम् ? विशेषस्वरूपं कीदृशम् ? समवायस्य च स्वरूपं कीदृशम् ? इत्यादिप्रश्नाः नूनमेव मनसि परिभ्रमेयुः । तादृशाशङ्कानिरसनायैवायमालेखः प्रस्तुतः । विशेषपदार्थस्य स्वरूपचिन्तनक्रमे सर्वप्रथमं कणाद–प्रशस्तपादाचार्य–विश्वनाथप्रभृतीनामाचार्याणां मतं विविच्य निष्कर्षरूपेण नित्यद्रव्यवृत्तित्वे सति स्वतोव्यावर्तकत्वं विशेषस्य लक्षणमिति प्रस्तुतम् । एवमेव निरवयवानां परमाणूनां परस्परं भेदसाधनाय विशेषः स्वीकर्तव्यः, अन्यथा घटपटादीनां परस्परं भेदो न स्यादेव । विशेषपदार्थस्वीकृतत्वादेव काणाददर्शनं वैशेषिकनाम्ना प्रथितमित्यादिचिन्तनमत्र प्रस्तुतं विद्यते । एवमेव समवायपदार्थविश्लेषणक्रमे सर्वप्रथमं समवायस्वरूपं प्रदश्र्य अयुतसिद्धवृत्तिसम्बन्धत्वं हि तल्लक्षणं निष्कर्षरूपेण   प्रस्तुतमत्र । ततः समवायसत्त्वे प्रमाणम्, तन्नित्यत्वम्, एकत्वम्, तस्य प्रत्यक्षत्वं वानुमेयत्वमित्यादिविवेचनपूर्वकमन्ते निष्कर्षः प्रदत्तो वर्तते । अस्मान्निष्कर्षान्न्यायवैशेषिकसम्बद्धयोः विशेषसमवायपदार्थयोरवबोधने जिज्ञासूनां कृतेऽयमालेख उपयोगी भविष्यतीत्यपेक्ष्यते ।
american_english: This present article is centered on examining the two categories, visesa and samavaya, in the Nyaya and Vaisheshika philosophies. In this article, prepared within a qualitative framework, the facts gathered through the library method are analyzed, and a conclusion is presented at the end. Here the nature of the two categories — visesa and samavaya — as accepted by the Nyaya-Vaisheshika teachers is analyzed. Among the astika philosophies, how did the Kanada philosophy become famous by the name Vaisheshika? What is the nature of visesa? And what is the nature of samavaya? Such questions are sure to swirl in the mind. This article has been presented precisely to dispel such doubts. In the course of examining the nature of the category visesa, first of all the views of teachers such as Kanada, Prashastapada and Vishvanatha are examined, and it is presented as a conclusion that visesa is defined as that which abides in eternal substances while distinguishing them by themselves. Likewise, visesa must be accepted in order to establish the mutual difference of indivisible atoms; otherwise there would be no difference at all between a pot and a cloth. Here it is presented as such reasoning that the Kanada philosophy became renowned by the name Vaisheshika precisely because the category of visesa was accepted. Likewise, in the course of analyzing the category samavaya, first presenting the nature of samavaya, its defining characteristic is presented here as a conclusion: samavaya is the relation of inherence in things established in inseparability (ayuta-siddha-vritti-sambandhatva). Then, after examining samavaya — the proof of its existence, its eternality, its oneness, and whether it is directly perceptible or inferable — a conclusion is given at the end. It is expected that, from these conclusions, this article will prove useful for the curious (jijnasu) in developing an understanding of the two categories connected with Nyaya-Vaisheshika, namely visesa and samavaya.

translator_notes: Source text is Sanskrit printed in Devanagari in the 'nepali' field. Sentence order preserved as in the source. 'प्रदश्र्य' read as प्रदर्शय ('having shown/presented'). The source's rhetorical questions are rendered as questions, not reordered.
